items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: when I was with Lionel Hampton... The musicians were such as Paul Howard, Lloyd Allen, Red Mack, Pee Wee Brice, Buster Wilson, and others.

ctx.x: Curtis Mosby had the Alabam and Red Mack's brother owned the Plantation.

items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: Red Mack, his name was McClure Morris, and his brother ran the Plantation out there on 107th and Central Avenue. Those are the two night-clubs I got mixed up.

ctx.x: Perhaps it will come to you--to the two of us.
Red Mack, his name was McClure Morris, and his brother ran the Plantation out there on 107th and Central Avenue. Those are the two night-clubs I got mixed up.
The Plantation was further out on Central, way, way out.
